item.title: How Trump’s ‘little detour’ to Iran became a roadblock in the midterm elections
item.description: When President Donald Trump launched his war on Iran, he said it would last a matter of weeks

item.title: Climber dies in 5,000-foot fall after reaching mountain's summit
item.description: Wolfgang Waschiczek fell to his death a day after reaching the summit of Ama Dablam mountain, according to a trekking company operator.

item.title: In Trump's pardon economy, victims lost out on $119M in restitution
item.description: Small businesses and retirees are left empty-handed as fraudsters, some represented by Trump allies, win clemency.

item.title: DOJ seeking to charge Comey with conspiring to disclose national defense information
item.description: The case relates to disclosures published in the New York Times in 2016.
